Lists all custom VCS integrations configured for an organization. Returns each integration's configuration, webhook URL, and configured repositories. Webhook secrets are not included in list responses.

Creates a new custom VCS integration for an organization. Custom VCS integrations allow connecting self-hosted or third-party version control systems (e.g. Gitea, Forgejo, Bitbucket Server) to Pulumi Deployments. Credentials are managed via ESC environments, and deployments are triggered by inbound webhooks. Returns the created integration including its webhook URL and HMAC secret for signature verification.

response.name: Invalid request: missing required fields or invalid vcsType
An integration with this name already exists in the organization

description.content: Removes a specific custom VCS integration from the organization. This permanently deletes the integration, its webhook endpoint, and all configured repository associations.

Gets a specific custom VCS integration by its integration ID. Returns the integration details including its configuration, webhook URL, and configured repositories. The webhook secret is not included; it is only returned at creation time or when regenerated via update.

Updates an existing custom VCS integration's settings. All fields are optional; only provided fields are modified. Set regenerateWebhookSecret to true to rotate the webhook HMAC secret, which invalidates the previous secret immediately.

response.name: Invalid request: invalid vcsType or other validation failure
